title: FlexLine Limit Increase Usage Share
content:
On FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit, the usage share scales a limit increase by the outstanding balance (the line's ledger entries added up, charges less payments and waivers) measured against the current credit limit on the decision date: more than 80% of it gives 0.60; more than 60% and no more than 80% gives 0.80; 60% or less gives 1.00.

The share multiplies the increase before it is added to the current credit limit and the sum rounded down.

**The outstanding balance here** adds up every ledger entry on the line: draws, draw fees, interest charges, annual fees, returned payments, late fees and returned-payment fees, less payments and fee waivers.

| Balance against the current limit | Share |
|---|---|
| more than 80% | 0.60 |
| more than 60%, up to and including 80% | 0.80 |
| 60% or less | 1.00 |

*Hypothetical boundary on a 7000.00 USD limit:* a balance of exactly 5600.00 USD (80%) gives 0.80; 5600.01 USD gives 0.60; exactly 4200.00 USD (60%) gives 1.00.
